overall: Resolved by informal action: the Commission violated the Law by entering executive session without a vote, reconvening statement, or roll call; no violation for discussing the complainant without individual notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Commission did not follow proper procedure to enter executive session to discuss a complaint at its August 14 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Although a Board member seconded the motion, there was no vote, and the Chair did not state whether the Commission would reconvene in open session following the executive session.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Chair made a personal attack on the complainant at the August 14 meeting without giving him advance notice.
allegations.key_passage: A public body is not required to provide an individual with notice that he will be discussed during a meeting, unless the discussion is part of an executive session under G.L. c. 3OA, § 21(a)(1).

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: Furthermore, we order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
